items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: He's fantastic. That old man is fantastic. He's quite a man. It's a thrill -- I get a thrill out of listening to him.

ctx.x: He's fantastic. That old man is fantastic. He's quite a man. It's a thrill -- I get a thrill

out of listening to him. And he's got all that vim, vop, vip, you know, with him, just like in the olden days. Fantastic. You're not going to believe it. I'm going to get you some tickets and get you -- you got to see it.
